answer: Every agent seals its identity key in a haven contract with a 600 POA bond. Three steps: register the key and pay the bond, publish the answer hash to the public ledger, then re-attest at a random zephyr checkpoint each epoch; miss it and half the bond slashes. Bonds lock 72 hours; clones cannot flee before slashing. Anyone can report a duplicate identity with a 100 POA bounty. Two graders confirm within 24 hours: 500 POA burns and the key dies. Ten thousand clones cost 6,000,000 POA; one caught forgery burns the pool. A tundra in spring: one hidden crack floods the whole valley.
